open.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: Now you. Understand what this is: men fall out of the sky with good English and good faces, and a week later forty people are ash. So — you are Travis Boyd, of Texas. Prove it in the small things.
Your turn, and we begin plainly: the last man with a good face cost a réseau forty people. You say Travis Boyd, Texas. Then Texas will answer for you — small things only.
Once more, then. I do not care about your war record; Berlin writes lovely war records. I care about the small true things. Travis Boyd of Texas — show me him.

q_town.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: Home. Not the state — the town. Exactly.
Begin with the town you were born in. Exactly.
Your town. The one on the enlistment paper, not the one Germans can find on a map.

choices.text: Houston. Big enough you'd have heard of it.

e_town_ok.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: Hempstead. The watermelon capital — you see, even here we read the almanacs. And your father grows...?
Hempstead, yes. Watermelon country, the almanac says. So the Boyd farm grows what, exactly?

e_town_wrong.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: Hm. When London reads your crew list back to us, we will hear what your own file says. Continue.
We will let London's copy of your file argue with you. Continue.

q_crop.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: The farm. What does it grow?
Answer for the farm — what comes out of that dirt?

choices.text: Cotton and watermelon. Watermelon's what we're known for.

e_crop_ok.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: So the almanac and the man agree. Good.
As the almanac has it. Good.

e_crop_wrong.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: A farm boy who cannot name his father's crop. Note it.
Curious. The crop changes when the son crosses an ocean. Note it.

q_ball.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: London sends us questions no German crammer thinks to study. Here is mine: Ebbets Field. Who plays there?
Now a question from London's list — the kind Berlin's schools skip. Ebbets Field: whose ground is it?

choices.text: The Dodgers. Our waist gunner never talked about anything else.

e_pat.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: Then tonight, say something for the waist gunner who talked. It is the ones who talk that we miss first.
Good. And a word tonight for that waist gunner — the talkers leave the biggest silence.

e_ball_wrong.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: The Yankees, in Ebbets Field. The Germans also study only the Yankees.
A Yankee answer. Berlin's crammers make the same economy.

e_ball_dodge.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: You flew eight months with a Brooklyn crew. Crews talk. That answer was cheap.
Cheap. No man flies with a Brooklyn crew and learns nothing.

search.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: Now empty the pockets on the crate. Slowly.
The pockets now. Everything, onto the crate. Slowly.
(The paper. The one your hand took without asking you, a lifetime ago, on a burning deck.)
(It is still there — the paper your glove closed around while the ship came apart.)

e_doc.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: This. It says BIGOT at the head, and it is no aircrew paper. What is it, and why does a tail gunner carry it?
And this — BIGOT, it reads. Not a gunner's paper, not any paper I have seen. Explain how it rides in your pocket.

choices.text: I grabbed it bailing out. Papers everywhere — I don't know what it is.
It's mine to carry. Orders. Give it back.
Never saw it before. Someone must have planted it.

e_doc_keep.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: No. I believe you do not know. Which is why it goes to London by a route that is not you, and you forget the word you saw.
That I believe. So it travels to London by another road, and the word at the top of it leaves your memory tonight.

e_doc_lie.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: A tail gunner under orders to carry staff papers. Now I am certain of exactly one thing about you.
Orders. To a tail gunner. You have told me one certain thing, and it is not the thing you wanted.

e_doc_shrug.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: It was in your pocket, and it walked there alone. Do not help me doubt you.
Planted. In the pocket of a falling man. Do not help me doubt you.

fail.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: Understand that it is nothing personal. We cannot afford to be wrong twice in one and the same night.
You answer like a man who studied a file. Files burn. I am sorry for it.
Too many small things fell wrong. In this work the small things are the man. Take him.

pass.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: The small things hold. Sit down — you look like a man who has stood for a year.
Enough. The small things agree with you, Travis Boyd of Hempstead. Sit.

clothes.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: Clothes are in the straw — French cloth, French razor. From tonight you are Jean Caillet, and at dawn you move west with Marcel.
In the straw: French clothes, a French razor. Jean Caillet rises at dawn and goes west with Marcel. You sleep first.
